prompts.rough: A low platform of driftwood planks on four wooden stilts, with a plank ladder. A long thin pole leans out diagonally toward the sky from the platform, held by two hemp ropes pegged to the ground. Three rusty iron barrel hoops are threaded along the pole like rings on a rod, the nearest one large enough to look through. A single small lantern hangs at the last hoop. There is no weight, no net and no lever arm: the pole is fixed and still. A bearded old man in a long grey robe sits on a stool on the platform and holds a short fishing rod with its line dropped in a wooden bucket.
prompts.grand: A small square lodge of warm stone with a tall steep tiled roof, and from its corner a double mast of dark oak stands up, braced by four thick hemp stays to iron rings in the ground. A long tube made of seven copper hoops of decreasing size, green with patina, is threaded on a straight rail and rises diagonally from the mast gallery toward the upper left, its tip inside the picture. Bronze pulleys at the mast head, a wooden capstan on the ground. Only four thick cables, no thin lines. An old man in a long robe sleeps on a stool beside the capstan with a rod in his hand. Nothing hangs from the tube.
prompts.mythic: A small square stone lodge with a tall tiled roof, a double oak mast with a gallery, four thick taut hemp stays, and a long diagonal tube of nine copper hoops that sags a little under its own weight toward the upper left. From its tip hangs one thick rope, ending in a huge pale pitted moon, round and matte like a lump of chalk, with craters, much bigger than the rope, about a quarter as tall as the whole mast. One third of the moon is dark midnight blue with a few small painted stars and a band of green and blue dawn. The moon hangs still, straight below the tip, never swinging, never a ball on a lever. The rope is tied at the other end to a copper hook on the mast. One small figure on the gallery leans a shoulder against a bronze bar to hold the rope. A grey heron stands on a bucket at the foot.

prompts.rough: Two forked tree trunks of unequal height, one thick and short, one thinner and taller, each fork shaped like a shoulder, carry a small wooden platform. On it stands a small round dome of patched canvas stretched tight over a curved timber frame, with a narrow open slit in the dome, leaning a little to one side. The canvas is taut on its frame, never hanging, never draped. The dome is much wider than the two trunks. A short wooden spyglass sticks out of the slit. A lantern is hooked under the platform. An old man in a grey robe sits on a stool, on a big patched cushion.
prompts.grand: Two stone pillars of unequal height on a low square stone base with straight sides. From each pillar a head and a pair of shoulders emerge, still half inside the rough block, closed stone eyes, chisel marks, no arms and no hands visible. They carry a tall copper dome that is wider than both pillars together, the slit of the dome wide open toward the sky. Matte green-patina copper ribs, rough stone. No rings, no glowing, no beam. A small old man sleeps leaning against one block.
prompts.mythic: Two stone giants carry a big copper dome with an open slit on their shoulders. The right giant has stood up, tall, his back straight, both stone hands lifting the dome high over his shoulder; the left giant is still kneeling on one knee, half in the block. The dome is raised far above the low square base and leans to one side, its slit toward the sky. A round red-brown cushion is squashed on the right giant's shoulder under the dome. Between the copper ribs, panels of midnight blue with a few small painted stars and a band of green and blue dawn. The giants are rough, weathered, unfinished, moss on the stone, closed eyes, each with two arms and two hands only. A small old man sits on the stone foot eating a red apple.
